_doc: Bot cycle 57.4 (M3): scripted stress scenarios on the canonical list (paired: unperturbed vs perturbed on identical shuffles). Built by scripts/grixis_stress.py; schema test.schema.json. Not win rates.

records.mulligan: keep 2-5 lands with (lands + mana sources costing <= 2) >= 3; otherwise mulligan; always keep at 5 cards or fewer; bottom (London): excess lands beyond 4 first, then the highest mana value nonlands
records.seat: multiplayer, seat-agnostic (no turn-1 draw skip, CR 103.8c); first mulligan free (CR 103.5c)
records.scenario: commander_removed_once@T4: the commander is removed (to the command zone) at the end of the first turn >= T it is on the battlefield

scenario_metrics.method: share of perturbed games in which the scripted event happened (e.g. the commander was on the battlefield to be removed)
share of games with a commander removal in which the commander was recast by turn 10
turns from the first removal (end step) to the recast, among games where it was recast
share of removal games where the commander was recast within 2 turns

limitations: Goldfish stress test: one player, scripted perturbations, no opponents; never a win rate.
v1.0 model: no tutors, card draw beyond the natural draw, treasures, rituals or one-shot mana; conditional fast mana unconditional; no cleanup discard.

The graveyard holds only what the model puts there (cast instants/sorceries, countered or destroyed cards); self-mill and recursion are not modelled, so graveyard_exiled mostly measures nothing in this model.
A graveyard piece counts toward a combo only when some piece of that combo mentions a graveyard in its Oracle text (recursion assumed, not simulated).
